svg.title: Deployment, environments and secrets
svg.desc: One deploy path, not two. Cloudflare builds from its own Git connection: it clones the repository, runs the build and deploys a Worker that serves dist and routes /api/* (AD10). GitHub Actions deploys nothing and holds no credential; it runs the tests and the drift checks, and branch protection makes them required. The gate on production is therefore the merge, performed by a person who has applied the migrations first (AD9).
